sources.title: MameLoshnLM: 8B Yiddish model built on Llama 3.1 lands at COLM
sources.snippet: MameLoshnLM is an 8-billion parameter Yiddish model built by continuing pretraining of Llama 3.1 8B, accepted at COLM 2026. The release bundles a new pretraining corpus called Oytser and a multi-task benchmark called Kashes covering translation, linguistic analysis and language understanding.
